boundaries.subject: MissionOptionData
boundaries.finding: missionId and callDialogId are mutually exclusive action alternatives in the reviewed native fallback; their co-carriage creates no mission-to-dialog causality, Story ownership, or order edge.
boundaries.boundary: The reviewed export contained no exact authored MissionOptionData instance. Dynamic construction, reflection, server-only state, future IFix, and future builds remain outside this boundary.

boundaries.subject: MissionRuntimeAsset properties and ParamVariable script pointers
boundaries.finding: Mission properties are authored or server-synchronized values, while the LevelScript pointer is attached later for local event subscriptions. The nested managed type shape is not a mission-to-LevelScript foreign key.
boundaries.boundary: The client evaluator and inbound property update path do not reveal the server rule or timing that changes a property, and do not prove quest lifecycle or Story playback.

boundaries.subject: ParamSource.CURRENT_MISSION_ID
boundaries.finding: CURRENT_MISSION_ID is an implicit action-context source whose reviewed authored uses remain within their already explicit MissionRuntime owner and provide no Story identity.
boundaries.boundary: An implicit current mission value alone does not establish a mission-to-LevelScript, mission-to-Story, quest, or order edge.

boundaries.subject: Direct managed mission, quest, LevelScript, and Story co-carriers
boundaries.finding: The reviewed current-build metadata has no open direct managed identity co-carrier. Productive carriers are represented by their owning runtime contracts; tracking types, editor enums, static catalogs, and inactive alternatives add no graph edge.
boundaries.boundary: Type co-carriage is an inventory signal only. It does not establish that values belong to one authored instance or that one identity owns another.

boundaries.subject: Nested managed identity reachability
boundaries.finding: Nested reachability through mutable Entity components, global managers, MissionRuntime aggregates, or the active XLua pending-submission bridge does not provide an authored same-record join. The reviewed submission bridge has exact quest requirements but no quest-to-OpenUI or order edge.
boundaries.boundary: Dynamic mutation, reflection, native-only opaque objects, server-only state, unexported asset kinds, future IFix, and future builds remain outside this boundary.
